build_ascii_barplot_categorical: build an ASCII grouped barplot comparing weighted proportions of a categorical column across multiple datasets
build_ascii_histogram_numeric: build an ASCII histogram comparing weighted distributions of a numeric column across multiple datasets
build_ascii_comparative_histogram: build a columnar ASCII histogram showing excess and deficit relative to a baseline dataset
build_ascii_distribution_plots: build ASCII distribution plots for all variables auto-classifying each as categorical or numeric
build_weighted_histogram_proportions: build a weighted histogram normalized to proportions using pre-computed bin edges and optional weights
